title.zh: 大學課程該維持線上嗎？

subtitle: 討論線上課程能否取代實體課，並提出有層次的立場
task: Some people believe that most university lectures should now be taught online. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and relevant examples.
taskZh: 有些人認為大部分大學課程現在應該改成線上授課。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？請提出理由與相關例子。
focus: 有層次的立場（承認對方優點再反駁）

en: Since the pandemic, many universities have continued to offer courses online, and some people now argue that most lectures should stay that way. While I agree that online learning has clear advantages, I do not believe it should replace classroom teaching for most university students.

Admittedly, online courses are convenient and flexible. Students who live far from campus save hours of commuting, and recorded lectures can be paused and replayed whenever a concept is difficult. For working adults or students with health problems, this flexibility can make the difference between studying and giving up.

However, university is about more than receiving information. In a classroom, students can ask follow-up questions immediately, notice how classmates think, and form study groups naturally. These small interactions are difficult to recreate on a video call, where many students keep their cameras off and quietly lose focus. Moreover, a fixed schedule helps students build discipline, whereas a fully online course requires a level of self-control that many eighteen-year-olds have not yet developed.

In conclusion, online learning works best as a supplement rather than a substitute. Universities should record lectures and offer online options for students who need them, but they should keep face-to-face classes at the heart of the university experience.
zh: 疫情以來，許多大學持續提供線上課程，現在也有人主張大部分課程應該維持線上。雖然我同意線上學習有明顯的優點，但我不認為它應該取代大多數大學生的實體課堂。
不可否認，線上課程既方便又有彈性。住得離學校遠的學生可以省下好幾個小時的通勤時間，而錄好的課程也能在遇到困難的概念時隨時暫停、重播。對在職成人或有健康問題的學生來說，這樣的彈性可能決定了他們是繼續學習還是放棄。
然而，上大學不只是接收資訊。在教室裡，學生可以立刻追問、觀察同學怎麼思考，也能自然地組成讀書會。這些小小的互動很難在視訊通話中重現，因為很多學生會關掉鏡頭，不知不覺就分心了。此外，固定的課表能幫助學生培養紀律，而完全線上的課程則需要很多十八歲學生還沒培養出來的自制力。
總而言之，線上學習最適合作為輔助，而不是替代。大學應該錄下課程，並為有需要的學生提供線上選項，但應該讓面對面的課程繼續成為大學經驗的核心。

patterns.pattern: While I agree that …, I do not believe …
patterns.zh: 雖然我同意……，但我不認為……（有層次的立場）
patterns.example: While I agree that online learning has clear advantages, I do not believe it should replace classroom teaching for most university students.

patterns.zh: 不可否認（先承認對方的論點）
patterns.example: Admittedly, online courses are convenient and flexible.

patterns.pattern: … can make the difference between A and B
patterns.zh: 可能決定是 A 還是 B
patterns.example: For working adults or students with health problems, this flexibility can make the difference between studying and giving up.
Moreover, a fixed schedule helps students build discipline, whereas a fully online course requires a level of self-control that many eighteen-year-olds have not yet developed.

patterns.pattern: … works best as A rather than B
patterns.zh: 最適合作為 A，而不是 B
patterns.example: In conclusion, online learning works best as a supplement rather than a substitute.

combine.answer: Although online courses are convenient, they cannot replace classroom teaching.
Universities should record lectures, but they should also keep face-to-face classes.

paraphrase.sentence: University is about more than receiving information.
answers: Going to university means much more than just getting information.
A university education involves more than absorbing facts.

paraphrase.sentence: Online learning works best as a supplement rather than a substitute.
answers: Online learning should support classroom teaching, not replace it.
Online classes are most useful when they add to face-to-face teaching instead of replacing it.
